title: Multiply one chance per independent point
spoken: The probability W is f to the power n.
explanation: Each of n independent points is inside the fraction f of the volume with probability f, so the chance that all of them are inside at once is f multiplied by itself n times. Independence does the work: four labels on one shared position would give f, not f to the fourth.
assumptions: n points move independently of one another, each equally likely to be anywhere in the volume V_0.
The chosen part V is a fraction f = V/V_0 of that volume.
These are modern teaching equations in SI notation, not a transcription of the printed paper.

notes.title: f multiplied by itself n times
notes.explanation: One factor of f for each point. Only independent chances multiply like this.

notes.title: What it asserts
notes.explanation: The chance that every point is inside at once is the product of their separate chances.

notes.title: Number of independent points
notes.explanation: How many points move independently of one another.

notes.title: Fraction of the volume
notes.explanation: The share of the volume the points must all be in, V over V_0; between 0 and 1.

notes.title: Probability of the configuration
notes.explanation: The chance that, at one instant, all n points are in the chosen part of the volume.

sentence.text: of the volume is f multiplied by itself n times.
